evidence.quote: These healthy inputs drove exceptional outputs, with gross bookings up 22% year-on-year.
We generated $8.7 billion in adjusted EBITDA, up 35% and a phenomenal $9.8 billion in free cash flow, up 42%.

evidence.claim: Free cash flow was $9.8 billion, up 42%.
evidence.quote: We generated $8.7 billion in adjusted EBITDA, up 35% and a phenomenal $9.8 billion in free cash flow, up 42%.
Trips on our platform accelerated again to a 15 billion annual run rate, and our audience grew to more than 200 million monthly active users.

evidence.claim: MAPC growth accelerated from 14% to 18% YoY during 2025.
evidence.quote: Looking at 2025, we started the year with MAPC growth at about 14% year-on-year. We ended the year with MAPC growth at 18% year-on-year which is a very, very strong step-up.
And then finally, our membership program which has been a key investment area and still is growing 55% year-on-year that then supercharges that cohort that we are acquiring.

evidence.claim: Management is confident about forward momentum and growth investments.
evidence.quote: We started 2026 with a ton of momentum, a scaled and profitable platform and a clear operating framework to generate durable growth. This gives us the confidence to make targeted growth oriented investments aligned with the six strategic areas of focus that we outlined last quarter.

evidence.claim: AVs are expected to be a net positive for the ecosystem, with expansion to 15 cities by end of 2026.
evidence.quote: We expect to be in 15 cities by the end of this year and then expanding beyond that as well, which should actually increase kind of the wave of kind of the AV business that we're seeing behind us.

evidence.claim: Management is committed to aggressive share buybacks.
evidence.quote: As to your question on whether we would be returning 50% of free cash flows, based on our current visibility into what we are seeing, as well as the fact that our stock remains really cheap, we will continue to be aggressive buyers of our stock.

evidence.claim: Advertising business has potential beyond prior 2% penetration target.
evidence.quote: We had many years ago talked about 2% as the potential ceiling for penetration with delivery advertising. What we are seeing is that, the opportunity size here is potentially much larger.

evidence.claim: Expansion into less dense markets is a growth driver.
evidence.quote: Generally, growth in less dense markets is about, 1.5 times to 2 times more than growth in the middle of the big cities.

evidence.claim: Insurance costs are improving from a headwind to a tailwind.
evidence.quote: We are in a position where insurance is going from a deleveraging cost item to something that gives us leverage and that allows us to hold prices flat or better in certain markets.
We started 2026 with a ton of momentum, a scaled and profitable platform and a clear operating framework to generate durable growth.
